# Advance Account Hub through the native submit and shared forward path

The controller prevents the native submit default, returns if the submitted form is invalid, and deliberately falls through into forward handling. It captures the current step state and awaits the same transition method as the footer. The form templates include hidden submit buttons. Preserve that shared path so Enter uses validation and state capture rather than synthesizing a separate click transition. The current auto component validates name and email separately, so the historical whole-form simplification must not be described as its current contract. These conclusions come from static source inspection. No runtime test or accessibility session was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Account Hub native form submission.
